title: Private parser composition through ordinary readers
question: Do retained role and local referent proposals survive ordinary Reader, CLI and fresh MCP delivery?
method: Read exact retained HanLP and Maverick cuts and compare ordinary transports, omitting only the request capture UUID. Read p289 against its exact prior public receipt.
conclusion: Ordinary transports agree; the earlier p289 admission remains exactly readable. The retained Maverick scope lacks compatible nominal evidence. No new protected semantic gain or admission was established.
